comment: Only the eighth pair of outputs can be polyphonic, through 'Polyphony on 8th out'; the panel marks that row with a P. The TRG outputs have no family because Output TRG type changes what they carry. This version adds an OFS knob per track that the other two randLoops modules do not have, and drops the DEL, ADD, RND and CLR controls and the stored patterns.
